profile.about1: As a creative Full Stack Developer, I architect and build robust, scalable web solutions. I thrive on solving complex problems and transforming them into seamless, high-performance user experiences.
profile.about2: From database design to pixel-perfect UIs, I am dedicated to writing clean, maintainable code that drives innovation and delivers real value to users.

p1.title: E-Commerce React App
p1.desc: A fully responsive, mobile-first e-commerce app featuring product filtering, cart management, and interactive Swiper sliders. Built with React Router, Redux Thunk for state management, Axios for API calls, and Toastify notifications.

p2.title: Pizza Order SPA
p2.desc: A Single Page Application (SPA) designed for pizza ordering. Features form validation, client-side routing with React Router, API integration via Axios, and end-to-end testing with Cypress.

p3.title: Twitter Clone
p3.desc: A feature-rich social media platform with a Spring Boot backend and React frontend. Includes JWT authentication, real-time interactions (likes, retweets, comments), and a PostgreSQL database.

p4.title: Aesir Gambit
p4.desc: A Norse mythology-themed tactical dice and strategy game. Features an immersive 3D experience built using pure CSS 3D transforms and Framer Motion, managed by an asynchronous Zustand state machine, and powered by a custom heuristic AI engine with 3 difficulty levels.
